characters.name: Patrick
characters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving sprite from photo references. Asset type: ONE static 16-bit arcade fighting-game character sprite for the existing WEDOO roster. Images 1 and 2 are the SAME person's photographic identity and clothing references. Images 3 (ALBERTO.png) and 4 (ANGELA.png) are ONLY style, pose scale and canvas-layout references; do not copy their faces, hair or clothes. Match their hand-placed pixel-art look: crisp discrete square pixel clusters, dark thin pixel outlines, restrained 3-5-tone shade ramps, realistically proportioned body, face readable at sprite scale, no smooth painting or photorealistic texture. Match the reference's right-facing side-view idle fighting guard: full body, both clenched fists raised before chest/chin, elbows bent, knees slightly bent, stable wide staggered stance, lead foot toward screen-right, rear foot toward screen-left; head and gaze turned RIGHT. Keep face recognizable from BOTH photographs. ONE character only, no alternate views, no spritesheet, no labels, no lettering, no objects or scenery. Square 512x512 transparent RGBA canvas, real alpha transparency, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no white or colored backdrop, no frame, no ground plane or shadow. Match the existing sprite footprint: centered horizontally, crown near y90-100, soles at y430-435, approximately 335-345 pixels tall, generous empty transparent margins. Entire head, fists, both legs and both shoes visible and uncropped. This is a base sprite, not an animated sequence. Subject: Patrick, the stocky adult man in photos 1-2, with a rounded full face and prominent cheeks, short dark brown hair, minimal chin stubble, small black earpiece visible at the ear. Preserve his broad heavyset torso and natural proportions rather than turning him into a slim or muscular hero. Clothing exactly from the photo: open blue-white-black checkered long-sleeve shirt over a grey textured crew-neck sweater, black trousers, simple dark charcoal-grey casual shoes. Translate the checkered shirt into clean readable pixel checks. Calm focused fighting-guard expression. Preserve the facial profile from photo 2 and the body/clothing identity from photo 1.
